signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Elite pass rushers are a mix of strength, speed, and tenacity. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their win rate and block shed speed against one-on-one pass blocks.
Defenders with this ability use faster, more dominant pass rush moves while rushing from the edge of the defense.
Defenders with this ability are less likely to increase their blocker's resistance bars when performing shed wins
Pass rushers with this ability must spend double the pass rush points to perform a move but are granted dominant wins
Defenders with this ability use faster run shed moves for a better chance at shedding blocks against inside run plays.
Ballcarriers with this ability can quickly shift momentum, change direction, and turn the corner without sacrificing speed.
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke and spin animations.
Avoid stumbling when carrying the ball

signatureAbility.signatureActivationDescription: Make consecutive passes for 5+ yards in air
signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Elite quarterbacks are molded by endless hours of film study. When they enter the zone, they have full vision of the secondary's defensive coverage before the snap.
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all throws inside the numbers (except on high/low throws).
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all throws outside the numbers (except on high/low throws).
Passers with this ability can make all hot route and blocking adjustments twice as fast (excluding audibles).
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all lob or touch passes (except high/low and cross-body throws).
The game's top defenders excel in all situations. When they enter the zone, this ability increases their chance of defeating run blocks, and disrupting catches via tackles.
Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in any mid-field zone coverage, less than 20 yards from the LoS inside the numbers and 10-20 outside.
Defenders with this ability are rarely faked out by ballcarrier moves (and cannot be faked out when user-controlled).
Defenders with this ability force more catch knockouts and react quicker in any flat zone coverage, less than 10 yards from the LoS and outside the hash marks.
